scope: Pure source decision and actual legacy World shelter-block ownership controls. No native constructor/mesh/body/route/visual/performance acceptance. Existing historical3f native rail and motor opposite witnesses stay HOLD.
cases: a vehicle stop_position never supplies a generic roof/pole anchor
literal shelter=yes retains existence but does not manufacture roof geometry
valid ordinary passenger stop literal negative also wins
ordinary passenger-stop model stays explicitly legacy/unreviewed
absent source metadata preserves legacy behavior
stale point/identity, malformed point and unverified provenance cannot authorize a source gate
same-name/open platform shelter availability never becomes a centroid or half-arclength model station
literal stop-area membership improves association evidence only, not roof dimensions
one platform negative does not invent a global vehicle-stop shelter absence
deterministic source decision consumes no RNG and mutates no source/fleet input
the entire legacy shelter emitter is byte-identical apart from one source decision gate
actual World gate emits zero whole-unit triangles/colliders/signs while preexisting mapped roof geometry stays byte-identical
exact649 source data and all34POIs unchanged; current target stops remain UNKNOWN, no actor IDs assumed
